verdict.rationale: Angular's docs claim fine-grained reactivity via Signals for fast state updates, and community users credit its AOT compilation and strong rendering performance. However, no evidence explicitly says the compiler turns component templates into targeted DOM updates. The dirty-checking complaints describe the older AngularJS digest loop, not this compilation model, so they do not contradict it. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that the template compiler generates targeted DOM update code, details on how Signals map to specific DOM nodes, and independent hands-on corroboration for current Angular versions.
